headline: Heard security deposit disputes at 99 Loomis Street and 19 South Willard Street; 92 Intervale Avenue hearing did not take place.
summary: Tenants and landlords gave evidence and testimony at the first two hearings, and both hearings were closed. Afterward, the panel deliberated in private. The minutes do not state a ruling in any of the three cases.
plain_text:
BURLINGTON HOUSING BOARD OF REVIEW  
Monday, November 2, 2026, 6:30 p.m.  
** REMOTE and IN PERSON**  
645 Pine Street, Front Conference Room OR  
https://zoom.us/j/93428531870  
 
Minutes  
  
Board Members present: Joshua Wronski, Don Slish, and Dylan Shelby 
Staff present: Shay Brunvand 
Meeting called to order at 6:31 pm 
1. Nathan Schoenbrodt, Gustavo Botero, Nathan Smith, Timothy Smith, Finn Hummel, and Jack 
Dobbins (tenants); Kristen Feifert Clark and Brian Clark (landlords) Security Deposit Hearing, 
Re: 99 Loomis Street 
Present were Nathan Schoenbrodt, Gustavo Botero, Nathan Smith, Timothy Smith, Finn 
Hummel, Jack Dobbins, and Kristen Clark.  
Both parties presented their evidence and testimony. The hearing was closed.  
 
2. Kim Marcellino (tenant); WHN Properties, LLC (landlord) (security deposit case) re: 19 South 
Willard Street 
Present were Jim Brown and Kim Marcellino 
Parties were sworn in. Both parties presented their evidence and testimony. The hearing was 
closed.  
 
3. Rehema Abdi (tenant); Jason Seiler (landlord) (security deposit case) Re: 92 Intervale Avenue 
Present was Jason Seiler.  
Only one party appeared. The hearing did not take place.  
 
The meeting was adjourned at 8:38 pm 
 
The Board deliberated in private.
